2 शी शे॑ते & श॑यते (श॑य˚ति), pp. शयित (q.v.) lie,
sleep, rest. C. शाययति, ˚ते cause to lie down or go to sleep, lay
down, put on or in (loc.). D. शिशयिषते wish to sleep. — अति sleep
or go to rest before another (acc.);
 also = C. surpass, excel. व्यति
reach beyond, surpass (acc.). अधि lie in or on, mount, enter (acc.,
r. loc.). अनु lie on or in (acc. or loc.), lie down after another
(acc.);
 rue, repent. अभि lie upon (acc.). आ lie in or on (acc.).
अन्वा stretch, extend. प्रत्या lie before or in front of (acc.). उप
lie by or on (acc. or loc.). परि lie about, surround, encompass;
 be
at or in (acc.). प्र lie down upon (acc.). सम् be undecided or in
doubt, despair of (loc.);
 A. disagree about (acc.). — Cf. अतिशयित,
संशयित.
